verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਰਪਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਛੂ ਸਕਲ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖਤ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise niramal dharapan mai na chitr kachhoo sakal charitr chitr dhekhat dhikhaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a clean mirror has no image in it, but when one looks in it, it shows all the details in their true colours,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਬਰਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਰੀਤਿ ਸਕਲ ਬਰਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਰਨ ਬਨਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise niramal jal baran ateet reet sakal baran mil baran banaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as clean water is bereft of all shades of colours, but acquires the colour that it mixes with,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਸੁੰਧਰਾ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਰਹਿਤ ਅਉਖਧੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਉਪਜਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau basu(n)dharaa suaadh baasanaa rahit aaukhadhee anek ras ga(n)dh upajaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as Earth is free of all tastes and desires but produces myriads of herbs of different effects, plants capable of giving many types of medicinal and aromatic extracts,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਗਤਿ ਜੈਸੋ ਜੈਸੋ ਭਾਉ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਵਈ ॥੩੩੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise gurdhev sev alakh abhev gat jaiso jaiso bhaau taisee kaamanaa pujaaviee ||330||

en.bdb: Similarly with whatever sentiment one performs service of indescribable and inaccessible Lord-like True Guru, one's desires are filled accordingly. (330)
